# Satellite Map Tile Caching

## Problem

CaveChef users need offline access to satellite imagery for cave survey work in remote locations without internet. Currently, satellite tiles are fetched live from ESRI with no caching, making offline work impossible.

## Approach

### Architecture
1. **Backend**: `TileCache` struct in `src-tauri/src/cache/tiles.rs` using SQLite (rusqlite)
2. **Protocol**: `register_asynchronous_uri_scheme_protocol("cavechef-tiles", ...)` in lib.rs
3. **Frontend**: MapLibre `addProtocol('cavechef-tiles', ...)` registered in MapCanvas useEffect
4. **Threading**: `Mutex<TileCache>` in AppState, request deduplication via in-flight tracking

### Key Decisions (from interview)
- **Cache limit**: 500MB hard limit, auto-evict oldest tiles before new writes
- **Request dedup**: Track in-flight requests, serve same result to all waiters
- **TTL**: 30 days default, configurable in Settings
- **Retry**: 3x with exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s)
- **Offline detection**: `navigator.onLine` + consecutive failure count
- **Cache location**: Platform app data dir (~/.local/share/cavechef/ on Linux)
- **Timeout**: 5 seconds default, configurable
- **Concurrency**: 4 simultaneous fetches, configurable
- **Invalid data**: Validate Content-Type header, reject non-images with warning log
- **Zero-byte tiles**: Cache as-is (some providers use for "no data" areas)
- **DB locking**: Queue and retry with backoff
- **Schema migration**: Drop and recreate on version change
- **Startup**: Validate integrity, recreate if corrupt
- **Stale refresh**: Spawn thread per stale tile (stale-while-revalidate)
- **Logging**: Configurable level (errors, stats, verbose)
- **Priority**: Visible tiles before prefetch
- **Memory**: Disk-only cache, no in-memory tier
- **Default**: Satellite enabled by default (global config)
- **Scope**: Shared global cache across all projects
- **Provider column**: Yes, for future extensibility (ESRI only for now)
- **Zoom levels**: Cache all (0-22)

### Settings UI
- Location: Settings → Storage section
- Stats shown: Tile count + total MB
- Clear button: No confirmation needed
- Configurable: TTL days, max MB, timeout, concurrent fetches, log level

### Offline Indicator
- Location: Status bar (bottom)
- Text: "Offline" (minimal)
- Cache miss: Show background color (existing behavior)
- Low disk warning: At 1GB remaining

### Testing
- Playwright mocks: Return colored pixel based on z/x/y
- WebdriverIO: Verify cache stats increase, network requests to ESRI, SQLite file exists
- Rust unit tests: LRU eviction, concurrent access, TTL expiration, performance (<10ms lookup)
- Test fixture: Fixed lat/lng location for reproducible tile coordinates
- Edge cases: Rapid toggle, network disconnect mid-fetch, cache full at high zoom

## Edge Cases

- **Concurrent duplicate requests**: Queue waiters, serve single result to all
- **Cache full during write**: Evict 10% oldest before storing new tile
- **Network drops mid-fetch**: Retry 3x, then fail gracefully
- **Zero-byte response**: Cache as valid "no data" tile
- **Invalid content-type**: Reject, log warning, don't cache
- **DB locked**: Queue with backoff retry
- **Corrupt cache**: Delete and recreate on integrity check failure
- **Disk full**: Log error, disable caching, show low-disk warning
- **Stale tile**: Serve immediately, refresh in background thread

## Quick commands

```bash
# Type check
pnpm tsc --noEmit

# Run Playwright tests
pnpm test:ui

# Run Rust tests (all)
cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml

# Run Rust cache tests only
cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml cache

# Manual verification
./scripts/dev.sh
# Create project → Toggle satellite → Check Settings → Storage section → Cache stats
```

## Acceptance

- [ ] Satellite tiles load via custom protocol (`cavechef-tiles://` in network tab)
- [ ] Cache stats visible in Settings → Storage (tile count, MB used)
- [ ] Clear cache button works (stats reset to 0)
- [ ] Previously-viewed tiles load instantly when satellite re-enabled
- [ ] App works offline with cached tiles (background color where not cached)
- [ ] Offline indicator shows "Offline" in status bar when disconnected
- [ ] Low disk warning appears when <1GB remaining
- [ ] Stale tiles served immediately with background refresh
- [ ] Integrity check runs on startup, recreates cache if corrupt
- [ ] All tests pass: `pnpm tsc`, `pnpm test:ui`, `cargo test`
- [ ] Cache lookup <10ms (performance benchmark)

## References

- Original plan: `~/.claude/plans/wondrous-cooking-orbit.md`
- SPEC.md Section 2.6 (Offline Support), 13.5 (Tile Caching)
- MapCanvas.tsx lines 654-741 (current satellite impl)
- Tauri docs: `register_asynchronous_uri_scheme_protocol`
- MapLibre: `addProtocol()` API
- ESRI ToS: Verified caching allowed for personal use

# fn-1-0u5.2 Implement TileCache module with Rust unit tests

## Description
Implement SQLite-based tile cache with comprehensive Rust unit tests.

## Files to create
- `src-tauri/src/cache/mod.rs` - Module exports
- `src-tauri/src/cache/tiles.rs` - TileCache implementation + tests

## Key implementation

### Schema
```sql
CREATE TABLE tiles (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    provider TEXT NOT NULL,
    z INTEGER NOT NULL, y INTEGER NOT NULL, x INTEGER NOT NULL,
    data BLOB NOT NULL,
    content_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'image/jpeg',
    size_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL,
    fetched_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    accessed_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE(provider, z, y, x)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_tiles_accessed ON tiles(accessed_at);
```

### TileCache struct
```rust
impl TileCache {
    pub fn open(cache_dir: &Path, max_mb: u32, ttl_days: u32) -> Result<Self>;
    pub fn get(&mut self, provider: &str, z: u32, y: u32, x: u32) -> Option<TileEntry>;
    pub fn put(&mut self, provider: &str, z: u32, y: u32, x: u32, data: &[u8], content_type: &str) -> Result<()>;
    pub fn evict_lru(&mut self) -> Result<u64>; // returns bytes freed
    pub fn clear_all(&mut self) -> Result<()>;
    pub fn clear_provider(&mut self, provider: &str) -> Result<()>;
    pub fn get_stats(&self) -> CacheStats;
}
```

## Unit tests (~15 tests)
- put and get roundtrip
- cache miss returns None
- LRU eviction (exceed max_mb, verify oldest evicted)
- TTL expiration (stale tiles not returned)
- clear_all removes all tiles
- clear_provider only removes specified provider
- cache_stats returns correct counts
- concurrent access (multi-threaded)
- different providers isolation
- zero-byte tile handling
- content-type preservation
- accessed_at updates on get
## Acceptance
- [ ] `src-tauri/src/cache/mod.rs` exists with `pub mod tiles`
- [ ] TileCache struct has all methods listed above
- [ ] SQLite schema matches spec
- [ ] At least 10 unit tests in `#[cfg(test)]` module
- [ ] LRU eviction removes oldest tiles first
- [ ] TTL expiration filters out stale tiles
- [ ] `cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml cache` passes with all tests green

# fn-1-0u5.3 Register custom protocol handler

## Description
Register custom Tauri protocol handler for cache-first tile serving.

## Files to modify
- `src-tauri/src/lib.rs` - Register protocol handler
- `src-tauri/src/core/state.rs` - Add TileCache to AppState
- `src-tauri/Cargo.toml` - Add ureq dependency for HTTP

## Implementation

### Add ureq dependency
```toml
[dependencies]
ureq = "3"
```

### AppState addition
```rust
pub struct AppState {
    // ... existing fields ...
    tile_cache: Mutex<Option<TileCache>>,
}
```

### Protocol handler registration
```rust
.register_asynchronous_uri_scheme_protocol("cavechef-tiles", |ctx, request, responder| {
    let state = ctx.app_handle().state::<AppState>();
    let path = request.uri().path(); // /esri/{z}/{y}/{x}
    
    std::thread::spawn(move || {
        // Parse z/y/x from path
        // Check cache
        // If miss, fetch from ESRI URL
        // Cache the result
        // Respond with tile data
    });
})
```

### Tile URL format
- Request: `cavechef-tiles://esri/{z}/{y}/{x}`
- ESRI source: `https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}`

## Error handling
- Network timeout: 10 seconds
- On fetch error: return 404 if no cached tile
- On parse error: return 400 Bad Request
## Acceptance
- [ ] ureq added to Cargo.toml dependencies
- [ ] AppState has `tile_cache: Mutex<Option<TileCache>>` field
- [ ] Protocol handler registered for "cavechef-tiles"
- [ ] Handler runs in separate thread (non-blocking)

        attribution: '© Esri, Maxar, Earthstar Geographics',

### MapLibre addProtocol registration
- `src/components/Map/MapCanvas.tsx` - Add useEffect for protocol registration

```typescript
useEffect(() => {
    maplibregl.addProtocol('cavechef-tiles', async (params, abortController) => {
        const response = await fetch(params.url, { signal: abortController.signal });
        return { data: await response.arrayBuffer() };
    });
    return () => maplibregl.removeProtocol('cavechef-tiles');
}, []);
```
